//go:build windows

package windows

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"
	"time"
	"unicode/utf16"

	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/smb"
	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/storage"
	win "golang.org/x/sys/windows"
)

// This test is injected only into the pinned diagnostic prototype checkout.
// A passing variant is feasibility evidence, not acceptance of the PR's implementation.
type cacheGateEvent struct {
	At     time.Time
	Kind   string
	Fields json.RawMessage
}
type cacheGateTrace struct {
	mu            sync.Mutex
	events        []cacheGateEvent
	overflow      bool
	encodingError error
}

var cacheGateActive atomic.Pointer[cacheGateTrace]

func cacheGateObserve(kind string, fields any) {
	trace := cacheGateActive.Load()
	if trace == nil {
		return
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(fields)
	trace.mu.Lock()
	defer trace.mu.Unlock()
	if err != nil {
		trace.encodingError = err
		return
	}
	if len(trace.events) == 2048 {
		trace.overflow = true
		return
	}
	trace.events = append(trace.events, cacheGateEvent{At: time.Now().UTC(), Kind: kind, Fields: encoded})
}

func cacheGateDirectory(t *testing.T, path string) *nativeHandle {
	t.Helper()
	name, err := win.UTF16PtrFromString(path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	h, err := win.CreateFile(name, win.FILE_LIST_DIRECTORY|win.FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES|win.READ_CONTROL|win.SYNCHRONIZE, win.FILE_SHARE_READ|win.FILE_SHARE_WRITE|win.FILE_SHARE_DELETE, nil, win.OPEN_EXISTING, win.FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS|win.FILE_FLAG_OVERLAPPED, 0)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("open held parent directory: %v", err)
	}
	file := &nativeHandle{value: h}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if err := file.close(); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	})
	cacheGateObserve("parent_open", map[string]any{"path": path})
	return file
}

type cacheGateWatch struct {
	file     *nativeHandle
	event    win.Handle
	overlap  win.Overlapped
	buffer   []byte
	done     bool
	observed bool
}

func cacheGateStartWatch(t *testing.T, file *nativeHandle) *cacheGateWatch {
	t.Helper()
	event, err := win.CreateEvent(nil, 1, 0, nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	w := &cacheGateWatch{file: file, event: event, buffer: make([]byte, 64<<10)}
	w.overlap.HEvent = event
	err = win.ReadDirectoryChanges(file.value, &w.buffer[0], uint32(len(w.buffer)), true, win.FILE_NOTIFY_CHANGE_FILE_NAME|win.FILE_NOTIFY_CHANGE_DIR_NAME, nil, &w.overlap, 0)
	if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, win.ERROR_IO_PENDING) {
		_ = win.CloseHandle(event)
		t.Fatalf("arm parent change notification: %v", err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if !w.done {
			err := win.CancelIoEx(file.value, &w.overlap)
			if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, win.ERROR_NOT_FOUND) {
				t.Errorf("cancel notification: %v", err)
			}
			// The OVERLAPPED and buffer stay owned until cancellation completes.
			// The isolated test process has a three-minute watchdog for a wedged driver.
			// https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/ioapiset/nf-ioapiset-cancelioex
			var count uint32
			if err := win.GetOverlappedResult(file.value, &w.overlap, &count, true); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, win.ERROR_OPERATION_ABORTED) {
				t.Errorf("notification completion: %v", err)
			}
		}
		if err := win.CloseHandle(event); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
		runtime.KeepAlive(w)
	})
	cacheGateObserve("notify_armed", nil)
	return w
}

func (w *cacheGateWatch) poll(t *testing.T) {
	t.Helper()
	if w.done {
		return
	}
	status, err := win.WaitForSingleObject(w.event, 0)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if status == uint32(win.WAIT_TIMEOUT) {
		return
	}
	if status != uint32(win.WAIT_OBJECT_0) {
		t.Fatalf("notification wait status=%d", status)
	}
	var count uint32
	err = win.GetOverlappedResult(w.file.value, &w.overlap, &count, false)
	w.done = true
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("native directory notification: %v", err)
	}
	if count == 0 || count > uint32(len(w.buffer)) {
		t.Fatalf("native notification returned invalid byte count %d", count)
	}
	for data := w.buffer[:count]; len(data) > 0; {
		if len(data) < 12 {
			t.Fatal("truncated native notification")
		}
		next := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data)
		action := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[4:8])
		length := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[8:12])
		if length&1 != 0 || uint64(length)+12 > uint64(len(data)) {
			t.Fatal("invalid native notification name")
		}
		words := make([]uint16, length/2)
		for i := range words {
			words[i] = binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(data[12+2*i:])
		}
		name := string(utf16.Decode(words))
		cacheGateObserve("notify_completed", map[string]any{"action": action, "name": name})
		if action == win.FILE_ACTION_ADDED && strings.EqualFold(name, "new.bin") {
			w.observed = true
		}
		if next == 0 {
			break
		}
		if next < 12 || next&3 != 0 || uint64(next) > uint64(len(data)) {
			t.Fatal("invalid native notification chain")
		}
		data = data[next:]
	}
}

func cacheGateAwaitNotify(t *testing.T, trace *cacheGateTrace) {
	t.Helper()
	deadline := time.Now().Add(5 * time.Second)
	for {
		trace.mu.Lock()
		pending := false
		for _, event := range trace.events {
			if event.Kind != "smb_headers" {
				continue
			}
			var header nativeHeaderObservation
			if err := json.Unmarshal(event.Fields, &header); err != nil {
				trace.mu.Unlock()
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if header.Response && header.Command == 15 {
				if header.Status == 0x103 {
					pending = true
				} else if header.Status != 0 {
					trace.mu.Unlock()
					t.Fatalf("CHANGE_NOTIFY admission failed with 0x%x", header.Status)
				}
			}
		}
		trace.mu.Unlock()
		if pending {
			cacheGateObserve("notify_pending_received", nil)
			return
		}
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			t.Fatal("native directory watcher did not reach an admitted SMB CHANGE_NOTIFY")
		}
		time.Sleep(time.Millisecond)
	}
}

func cacheGateAwaitMissingName(t *testing.T, trace *cacheGateTrace, after uint64, name string) {
	t.Helper()
	deadline := time.Now().Add(time.Second)
	for {
		trace.mu.Lock()
		events := append([]cacheGateEvent(nil), trace.events...)
		trace.mu.Unlock()
		requests := make(map[uint64]bool)
		for _, event := range events {
			if event.Kind != "smb_creates" {
				continue
			}
			var request nativeCreateObservation
			if err := json.Unmarshal(event.Fields, &request); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if request.Sequence > after && strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimPrefix(request.Name, `\`), name) {
				requests[request.MessageID] = true
			}
		}
		for _, event := range events {
			if event.Kind != "smb_headers" {
				continue
			}
			var header nativeHeaderObservation
			if err := json.Unmarshal(event.Fields, &header); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if header.Response && header.Command == 5 && header.Status == 0xc0000034 && requests[header.MessageID] {
				cacheGateObserve("authoritative_negative_confirmed", map[string]uint64{"message_id": header.MessageID})
				return
			}
		}
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			t.Fatal("initial absence had no observed authoritative CREATE/NAME_NOT_FOUND response")
		}
		time.Sleep(time.Millisecond)
	}
}

func TestNativeNegativeNameCacheGate(t *testing.T) {
	variant := os.Getenv("RFS_GATE_VARIANT")
	if variant == "directory_sharing" {
		cacheGateSharingScenario(t)
		return
	}
	if variant == "owned_nested" || variant == "owned_lifecycle" || variant == "owned_outage" || variant == "owned_rescan" || variant == "find_notification" {
		cacheGateOwnedScenario(t, variant)
		return
	}
	if variant != "baseline" && variant != "held_parent" && variant != "notify_parent" {
		t.Fatalf("invalid gate variant %q", variant)
	}
	output := os.Getenv("RFS_GATE_OUTPUT_ROOT")
	if output == "" {
		t.Fatal("gate receipt output directory is required")
	}
	ttl, err := strconv.ParseUint(os.Getenv("RFS_GATE_MIN_CACHE_TTL"), 10, 32)
	if err != nil || ttl <= 1 {
		t.Fatal("a verified cache lifetime above one second is required")
	}
	trace := &cacheGateTrace{}
	cacheGateActive.Store(trace)
	var bridge *nativeBridge
	var negativeStarted, earliestExpiry, writerAcknowledged, visibleAt time.Time
	var attempts, freshQueries int
	var watch *cacheGateWatch
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		cacheGateActive.Store(nil)
		trace.mu.Lock()
		events := append([]cacheGateEvent(nil), trace.events...)
		overflow, encodingError := trace.overflow, trace.encodingError
		trace.mu.Unlock()
		if overflow || encodingError != nil {
			t.Errorf("bounded trace incomplete: overflow=%v error=%v", overflow, encodingError)
		}
		report := map[string]any{
			"evidence_kind": "pinned prototype diagnostic; not PR implementation acceptance",
			"overlay_sha":   os.Getenv("RFS_GATE_OVERLAY_SHA"), "fixture_sha": os.Getenv("RFS_GATE_FIXTURE_SHA"), "gate_sha": os.Getenv("GITHUB_SHA"), "variant": variant,
			"negative_lookup_started_at": negativeStarted, "earliest_possible_cache_expiry": earliestExpiry,
			"writer_acknowledged_at": writerAcknowledged, "visible_at": visibleAt, "attempts": attempts, "fresh_queries": freshQueries,
			"test_failed": t.Failed(), "trace_overflow": overflow, "events": events,
		}
		if watch != nil {
			report["matching_notification_received"] = watch.observed
		}
		if bridge != nil {
			report["final_server_status"] = bridge.smb.Status()
			report["final_backend_references"] = bridge.backend.openReferences()
			report["owned_mapping"] = map[string]string{"local": bridge.path, "remote": fmt.Sprintf(`\\127.0.0.1\%s`, bridge.share)}
		}
		encoded, err := json.MarshalIndent(report, "", "  ")
		if err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
			return
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(output, "receipt.json"), encoded, 0600); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
		t.Logf("GATE_RESULT variant=%s failed=%v attempts=%d fresh_queries=%d writer_ack=%s visible=%s", variant, t.Failed(), attempts, freshQueries, writerAcknowledged.Format(time.RFC3339Nano), visibleAt.Format(time.RFC3339Nano))
	})
	sid, err := CurrentUserSID()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	policy, err := AllowSID(sid)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	bridge = nativeBridgeFixture(t, policy)
	if err := bridge.mapDrive(t); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	cacheGateObserve("mapping_ready", map[string]any{"variant": variant, "port": bridge.port})
	warm := nativeOpen(t, filepath.Join(bridge.path+`\`, "live.bin"), win.CREATE_ALWAYS)
	payload := []byte("before-remote")
	if n, err := nativeTransfer(warm, payload, true); err != nil || n != uint32(len(payload)) {
		t.Fatalf("warm write: count=%d error=%v", n, err)
	}
	session, remote := nativeRemoteOpen(t, bridge.remote, "live.bin", storage.NodeRegular, false)
	updated := []byte("after--remote")
	nativeRemoteWrite(t, session, remote, updated)
	buffer := make([]byte, len(updated))
	if n, err := nativeTransfer(warm, buffer, false); err != nil || n != uint32(len(buffer)) || !bytes.Equal(buffer, updated) {
		t.Fatalf("warm remote read: count=%d error=%v", n, err)
	}
	bridge.assertCacheContract(t)
	if variant != "baseline" {
		parent := cacheGateDirectory(t, bridge.path+`\`)
		if variant == "notify_parent" {
			watch = cacheGateStartWatch(t, parent)
			cacheGateAwaitNotify(t, trace)
		}
	}
	missing := filepath.Join(bridge.path+`\`, "new.bin")
	beforeNegative := bridge.wire.createSequence.Load()
	negativeStarted = time.Now()
	earliestExpiry = negativeStarted.Add(time.Duration(ttl) * time.Second)
	cacheGateObserve("negative_lookup_started", nil)
	if _, err := os.Stat(missing); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		t.Fatalf("initial negative lookup: %v", err)
	}
	cacheGateObserve("negative_lookup_completed", nil)
	cacheGateAwaitMissingName(t, trace, beforeNegative, "new.bin")
	beforeFresh := bridge.wire.createSequence.Load()
	cacheGateObserve("remote_create_started", nil)
	_, _ = nativeRemoteOpen(t, bridge.remote, "new.bin", storage.NodeRegular, true)
	writerAcknowledged = time.Now()
	cacheGateObserve("remote_create_acknowledged", nil)
	if !writerAcknowledged.Before(earliestExpiry) {
		t.Fatal("remote creation completed after possible negative-cache expiry; probe is inconclusive")
	}
	deadline := writerAcknowledged.Add(time.Second)
	for {
		if watch != nil {
			watch.poll(t)
		}
		attempts++
		cacheGateObserve("lookup_started", map[string]int{"attempt": attempts})
		_, err := os.Stat(missing)
		completed := time.Now()
		cacheGateObserve("lookup_completed", map[string]any{"attempt": attempts, "exists": err == nil, "missing": os.IsNotExist(err)})
		if err != nil && !os.IsNotExist(err) {
			t.Fatalf("lookup after remote commit: %v", err)
		}
		if err == nil {
			visibleAt = completed
			break
		}
		if !completed.Before(deadline) {
			break
		}
		time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond)
	}
	trace.mu.Lock()
	events := append([]cacheGateEvent(nil), trace.events...)
	trace.mu.Unlock()
	for _, event := range events {
		if event.Kind != "smb_creates" {
			continue
		}
		var request nativeCreateObservation
		if err := json.Unmarshal(event.Fields, &request); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if request.Sequence > beforeFresh && strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimPrefix(request.Name, `\`), "new.bin") {
			freshQueries++
		}
	}
	if watch != nil {
		watch.poll(t)
	}
	bridge.assertCacheContract(t)
	if visibleAt.IsZero() || visibleAt.After(deadline) {
		t.Fatal("remote creation after a native negative lookup was not visible within one second")
	}
	if !visibleAt.Before(earliestExpiry) {
		t.Fatal("visibility occurred after possible cache expiry; TTL-independent visibility is not established")
	}
	if freshQueries == 0 {
		t.Fatal("visibility had no fresh authoritative SMB CREATE for the missing name")
	}
	if watch != nil && !watch.observed {
		t.Fatal("the admitted directory watcher delivered no matching creation notification")
	}
}

type cacheGatePause struct {
	reached chan struct{}
	resume  chan struct{}
	once    sync.Once
}

func (p *cacheGatePause) release() { p.once.Do(func() { close(p.resume) }) }

type cacheGateOwnedIO struct {
	event   win.Handle
	overlap win.Overlapped
	buffer  []byte
}

// The client owner drives notifications independently of application Stat calls.
// The injected pause models a slow rearm without closing the directory handle.
type cacheGateOwnedWatcher struct {
	file         *nativeHandle
	mu           sync.Mutex
	current      *cacheGateOwnedIO
	closing      bool
	failure      error
	cleanupError error
	pause        *cacheGatePause
	rescanPause  *cacheGatePause
	rescans      uint64
	stop         chan struct{}
	done         chan struct{}
}

func cacheGateStartOwned(t *testing.T, bridge *nativeBridge, trace *cacheGateTrace) *cacheGateOwnedWatcher {
	t.Helper()
	file := cacheGateDirectory(t, `\\127.0.0.1\`+bridge.share)
	w := &cacheGateOwnedWatcher{file: file, stop: make(chan struct{}), done: make(chan struct{})}
	go w.run()
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if err := w.close(); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
		if err := file.close(); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	})
	cacheGateAwaitNotify(t, trace)
	cacheGateObserve("owned_client_ready", nil)
	return w
}

func (w *cacheGateOwnedWatcher) close() error {
	w.mu.Lock()
	if !w.closing {
		w.closing = true
		close(w.stop)
		if w.current != nil {
			if err := win.CancelIoEx(w.file.value, &w.current.overlap); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, win.ERROR_NOT_FOUND) {
				w.cleanupError = err
				cacheGateObserve("owned_cancel_error", map[string]string{"error": err.Error()})
			}
		}
	}
	w.mu.Unlock()
	<-w.done
	cacheGateObserve("owned_client_stopped", nil)
	w.mu.Lock()
	defer w.mu.Unlock()
	return w.cleanupError
}

func (w *cacheGateOwnedWatcher) fail(err error) {
	w.mu.Lock()
	if !w.closing {
		w.failure = err
		cacheGateObserve("owned_watch_failed", map[string]string{"error": err.Error()})
	}
	w.mu.Unlock()
}

func (w *cacheGateOwnedWatcher) closeEvent(event win.Handle) error {
	err := win.CloseHandle(event)
	if err != nil {
		w.mu.Lock()
		w.cleanupError = errors.Join(w.cleanupError, err)
		w.mu.Unlock()
	}
	return err
}

func (w *cacheGateOwnedWatcher) pauseAfterNext(t *testing.T) *cacheGatePause {
	t.Helper()
	w.mu.Lock()
	defer w.mu.Unlock()
	if w.pause != nil || w.closing || w.failure != nil {
		t.Fatal("watcher cannot accept the rearm pause")
	}
	p := &cacheGatePause{reached: make(chan struct{}), resume: make(chan struct{})}
	w.pause = p
	t.Cleanup(p.release)
	return p
}

func (w *cacheGateOwnedWatcher) pauseAfterRescan(t *testing.T) *cacheGatePause {
	t.Helper()
	w.mu.Lock()
	defer w.mu.Unlock()
	if w.rescanPause != nil || w.closing || w.failure != nil {
		t.Fatal("watcher cannot pause after rescan")
	}
	p := &cacheGatePause{reached: make(chan struct{}), resume: make(chan struct{})}
	w.rescanPause = p
	t.Cleanup(p.release)
	return p
}

func (w *cacheGateOwnedWatcher) run() {
	defer close(w.done)
	for {
		event, err := win.CreateEvent(nil, 1, 0, nil)
		if err != nil {
			w.fail(err)
			return
		}
		op := &cacheGateOwnedIO{event: event, buffer: make([]byte, 64<<10)}
		op.overlap.HEvent = event
		w.mu.Lock()
		if w.closing {
			w.mu.Unlock()
			_ = w.closeEvent(event)
			return
		}
		w.current = op
		err = win.ReadDirectoryChanges(w.file.value, &op.buffer[0], uint32(len(op.buffer)), true, win.FILE_NOTIFY_CHANGE_FILE_NAME|win.FILE_NOTIFY_CHANGE_DIR_NAME, nil, &op.overlap, 0)
		w.mu.Unlock()
		if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, win.ERROR_IO_PENDING) {
			w.mu.Lock()
			w.current = nil
			w.mu.Unlock()
			_ = w.closeEvent(event)
			w.fail(err)
			return
		}
		cacheGateObserve("owned_notify_issued", nil)
		var count uint32
		err = win.GetOverlappedResult(w.file.value, &op.overlap, &count, true)
		rescanError := errors.Is(err, win.ERROR_NOTIFY_ENUM_DIR)
		if rescanError {
			err, count = nil, 0
		}
		w.mu.Lock()
		w.current = nil
		closing := w.closing
		pause := w.pause
		w.pause = nil
		if err == nil && count == 0 {
			w.rescans++
			if w.rescanPause != nil {
				pause = w.rescanPause
				w.rescanPause = nil
			}
		}
		w.mu.Unlock()
		closeErr := w.closeEvent(event)
		if closing {
			w.mu.Lock()
			if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, win.ERROR_OPERATION_ABORTED) {
				w.cleanupError = errors.Join(w.cleanupError, err)
			}
			w.mu.Unlock()
			runtime.KeepAlive(op)
			return
		}
		if err != nil || closeErr != nil {
			w.fail(errors.Join(err, closeErr))
			return
		}
		if count > uint32(len(op.buffer)) {
			w.fail(errors.New("native watcher lost event detail"))
			return
		}
		if count == 0 {
			// This owner keeps no directory snapshot or per-name event consumer.
			// Zero bytes mean lost detail, never an empty directory or no changes.
			// https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/winbase/nf-winbase-readdirectorychangesw
			cacheGateObserve("owned_notify_rescan", map[string]bool{"enum_error": rescanError})
		} else if err := cacheGateDecodeOwned(op.buffer[:count]); err != nil {
			w.fail(err)
			return
		}
		runtime.KeepAlive(op)
		if pause != nil {
			cacheGateObserve("owned_rearm_paused", nil)
			close(pause.reached)
			select {
			case <-pause.resume:
			case <-w.stop:
				return
			}
			cacheGateObserve("owned_rearm_resumed", nil)
		}
	}
}

func cacheGateDecodeOwned(data []byte) error {
	for len(data) > 0 {
		if len(data) < 12 {
			return errors.New("short native notification")
		}
		next := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data)
		action := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[4:8])
		length := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[8:12])
		if length&1 != 0 || uint64(length)+12 > uint64(len(data)) {
			return errors.New("invalid native notification name")
		}
		words := make([]uint16, length/2)
		for i := range words {
			words[i] = binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(data[12+2*i:])
		}
		cacheGateObserve("owned_notify_completed", map[string]any{"action": action, "name": string(utf16.Decode(words))})
		if next == 0 {
			return nil
		}
		if next < 12 || next&3 != 0 || uint64(next) > uint64(len(data)) {
			return errors.New("invalid native notification chain")
		}
		data = data[next:]
	}
	return nil
}

type cacheGateOwnedCheck struct {
	Name               string
	NegativeStarted    time.Time
	EarliestExpiry     time.Time
	WriterAcknowledged time.Time
	VisibleAt          time.Time
	BeforeFresh        uint64
	Attempts           int
	FreshQueries       int
}

type cacheGateOwnedProbe struct {
	bridge *nativeBridge
	trace  *cacheGateTrace
	ttl    time.Duration
	checks []*cacheGateOwnedCheck
}

func (p *cacheGateOwnedProbe) prime(t *testing.T, name string) *cacheGateOwnedCheck {
	t.Helper()
	check := &cacheGateOwnedCheck{Name: name, NegativeStarted: time.Now()}
	check.EarliestExpiry = check.NegativeStarted.Add(p.ttl)
	p.checks = append(p.checks, check)
	before := p.bridge.wire.createSequence.Load()
	cacheGateObserve("negative_lookup_started", map[string]string{"name": name})
	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(p.bridge.path+`\`, name)); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		t.Fatalf("initial negative lookup %s: %v", name, err)
	}
	cacheGateAwaitMissingName(t, p.trace, before, name)
	check.BeforeFresh = p.bridge.wire.createSequence.Load()
	return check
}

func (p *cacheGateOwnedProbe) acknowledged(t *testing.T, check *cacheGateOwnedCheck) {
	t.Helper()
	check.WriterAcknowledged = time.Now()
	cacheGateObserve("remote_create_acknowledged", map[string]string{"name": check.Name})
	if !check.WriterAcknowledged.Before(check.EarliestExpiry) {
		t.Fatal("writer ACK exceeded earliest cache expiry; diagnostic inconclusive")
	}
}

func (p *cacheGateOwnedProbe) visible(t *testing.T, check *cacheGateOwnedCheck) {
	t.Helper()
	deadline := check.WriterAcknowledged.Add(time.Second)
	for {
		check.Attempts++
		_, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(p.bridge.path+`\`, check.Name))
		completed := time.Now()
		cacheGateObserve("lookup_completed", map[string]any{"name": check.Name, "attempt": check.Attempts, "exists": err == nil, "missing": os.IsNotExist(err)})
		if err != nil && !os.IsNotExist(err) {
			t.Fatalf("lookup %s: %v", check.Name, err)
		}
		if err == nil {
			check.VisibleAt = completed
			break
		}
		if !completed.Before(deadline) {
			break
		}
		time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond)
	}
	p.trace.mu.Lock()
	events := append([]cacheGateEvent(nil), p.trace.events...)
	p.trace.mu.Unlock()
	for _, event := range events {
		if event.Kind != "smb_creates" {
			continue
		}
		var request nativeCreateObservation
		if err := json.Unmarshal(event.Fields, &request); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if request.Sequence > check.BeforeFresh && strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimPrefix(request.Name, `\`), check.Name) {
			check.FreshQueries++
		}
	}
	if check.VisibleAt.IsZero() || check.VisibleAt.After(deadline) {
		t.Fatalf("%s was not visible within one second of writer ACK", check.Name)
	}
	if !check.VisibleAt.Before(check.EarliestExpiry) {
		t.Fatalf("%s visibility did not precede possible cache expiry", check.Name)
	}
	if check.FreshQueries == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("%s had no fresh authoritative CREATE", check.Name)
	}
}

func cacheGateOwnedScenario(t *testing.T, variant string) {
	output := os.Getenv("RFS_GATE_OUTPUT_ROOT")
	ttl, err := strconv.ParseUint(os.Getenv("RFS_GATE_MIN_CACHE_TTL"), 10, 32)
	if output == "" || err != nil || ttl <= 1 {
		t.Fatal("receipt directory and verified cache TTL above one second are required")
	}
	p := &cacheGateOwnedProbe{trace: &cacheGateTrace{}, ttl: time.Duration(ttl) * time.Second}
	cacheGateActive.Store(p.trace)
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		cacheGateActive.Store(nil)
		p.trace.mu.Lock()
		events := append([]cacheGateEvent(nil), p.trace.events...)
		overflow, encodingErr := p.trace.overflow, p.trace.encodingError
		p.trace.mu.Unlock()
		if overflow || encodingErr != nil {
			t.Errorf("incomplete bounded trace: overflow=%v error=%v", overflow, encodingErr)
		}
		report := map[string]any{"evidence_kind": "pinned prototype diagnostic; not PR implementation acceptance", "overlay_sha": os.Getenv("RFS_GATE_OVERLAY_SHA"), "fixture_sha": os.Getenv("RFS_GATE_FIXTURE_SHA"), "gate_sha": os.Getenv("GITHUB_SHA"), "variant": variant, "checks": p.checks, "test_failed": t.Failed(), "trace_overflow": overflow, "events": events}
		if p.bridge != nil {
			report["final_server_status"] = p.bridge.smb.Status()
			report["final_backend_references"] = p.bridge.backend.openReferences()
			report["owned_mapping"] = map[string]string{"local": p.bridge.path, "remote": `\\127.0.0.1\` + p.bridge.share}
		}
		encoded, err := json.MarshalIndent(report, "", "  ")
		if err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
			return
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(output, "receipt.json"), encoded, 0600); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
		t.Logf("GATE_RESULT variant=%s failed=%v checks=%d", variant, t.Failed(), len(p.checks))
	})
	sid, err := CurrentUserSID()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	policy, err := AllowSID(sid)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	p.bridge = nativeBridgeFixture(t, policy)
	if err := p.bridge.mapDrive(t); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	cacheGateObserve("mapping_ready", map[string]any{"variant": variant, "port": p.bridge.port})
	warm := nativeOpen(t, filepath.Join(p.bridge.path+`\`, "live.bin"), win.CREATE_ALWAYS)
	if _, err := nativeTransfer(warm, []byte("warm"), true); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := warm.close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	p.bridge.assertCacheContract(t)
	session, root := nativeRemoteOpen(t, p.bridge.remote, "", storage.NodeDirectory, false)
	nested := nativeRemoteCreateAt(t, session, root, "nested", storage.NodeDirectory)
	deep := nativeRemoteCreateAt(t, session, nested, "deep", storage.NodeDirectory)
	if variant == "find_notification" {
		cacheGateFindCompatibility(t, p)
		p.bridge.assertCacheContract(t)
		return
	}
	w := cacheGateStartOwned(t, p.bridge, p.trace)
	switch variant {
	case "owned_nested":
		cacheGateOwnedNested(t, p, w, session, deep)
	case "owned_lifecycle":
		cacheGateOwnedLifecycle(t, p, w, session, root)
	case "owned_outage":
		cacheGateOwnedOutage(t, p, w)
	case "owned_rescan":
		cacheGateOwnedRescan(t, p, w, session, deep)
	default:
		t.Fatal("invalid owned variant")
	}
	p.bridge.assertCacheContract(t)
}

func cacheGateOwnedNested(t *testing.T, p *cacheGateOwnedProbe, w *cacheGateOwnedWatcher, session storage.FileSession, parent storage.File) {
	first := p.prime(t, `nested\deep\first.bin`)
	pause := w.pauseAfterNext(t)
	_ = nativeRemoteCreateAt(t, session, parent, "first.bin", storage.NodeRegular)
	p.acknowledged(t, first)
	p.visible(t, first)
	select {
	case <-pause.reached:
	case <-time.After(time.Second):
		t.Fatal("watcher did not enter controlled rearm gap")
	}
	gap := p.prime(t, `nested\deep\gap.bin`)
	_ = nativeRemoteCreateAt(t, session, parent, "gap.bin", storage.NodeRegular)
	p.acknowledged(t, gap)
	time.Sleep(100 * time.Millisecond)
	pause.release()
	p.visible(t, gap)
	burst := make([]*cacheGateOwnedCheck, 8)
	for i := range burst {
		burst[i] = p.prime(t, fmt.Sprintf(`nested\deep\burst-%d.bin`, i))
	}
	for i, check := range burst {
		_ = nativeRemoteCreateAt(t, session, parent, fmt.Sprintf("burst-%d.bin", i), storage.NodeRegular)
		p.acknowledged(t, check)
	}
	for _, check := range burst {
		p.visible(t, check)
	}
	p.notifications(t, p.checks[2].NegativeStarted)
	cacheGateAwaitHealthy(t, w, p.trace)
	w.mu.Lock()
	failure := w.failure
	w.mu.Unlock()
	if failure != nil {
		t.Fatalf("owned recursive watcher failed: %v", failure)
	}
}

func cacheGateOwnedLifecycle(t *testing.T, p *cacheGateOwnedProbe, w *cacheGateOwnedWatcher, session storage.FileSession, parent storage.File) {
	app := nativeOpen(t, filepath.Join(p.bridge.path+`\`, "app.bin"), win.CREATE_ALWAYS)
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(t.Context(), 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	err := p.bridge.mapping.Unmount(ctx)
	cacheGateObserve("owned_busy_unmount", map[string]any{"busy": errors.Is(err, ErrMappingBusy), "error": fmt.Sprint(err)})
	if !errors.Is(err, ErrMappingBusy) {
		t.Fatalf("unmount with application handle: %v", err)
	}
	check := p.prime(t, "after-busy.bin")
	_ = nativeRemoteCreateAt(t, session, parent, "after-busy.bin", storage.NodeRegular)
	p.acknowledged(t, check)
	p.visible(t, check)
	p.notifications(t, time.Time{})
	w.mu.Lock()
	failure := w.failure
	w.mu.Unlock()
	if failure != nil {
		t.Fatalf("owned watcher failed across busy unmount: %v", failure)
	}
	if err := app.close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	ctx2, cancel2 := context.WithTimeout(t.Context(), 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel2()
	err = p.bridge.mapping.Unmount(ctx2)
	cacheGateObserve("owned_internal_watch_unmount", map[string]any{"success": err == nil, "error": fmt.Sprint(err)})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("normal unmount with only client-owned UNC watcher: %v", err)
	}
	if err := w.close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := w.file.close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func cacheGateOwnedOutage(t *testing.T, p *cacheGateOwnedProbe, w *cacheGateOwnedWatcher) {
	check := p.prime(t, "outage-missing.bin")
	p.bridge.gate.down.Store(true)
	p.bridge.http.CloseClientConnections()
	t.Cleanup(func() { p.bridge.gate.down.Store(false) })
	cacheGateObserve("authority_outage_started", nil)
	select {
	case <-w.done:
	case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("owned watcher did not report the HTTP/SSE outage")
	}
	w.mu.Lock()
	failure := w.failure
	w.mu.Unlock()
	if failure == nil {
		t.Fatal("watcher stopped without surfacing the outage")
	}
	_, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(p.bridge.path+`\`, check.Name))
	observed := time.Now()
	cacheGateObserve("outage_negative_lookup", map[string]any{"missing": os.IsNotExist(err), "error": fmt.Sprint(err), "before_cache_expiry": observed.Before(check.EarliestExpiry)})
	if !observed.Before(check.EarliestExpiry) {
		t.Fatal("outage probe reached possible cache expiry; diagnostic inconclusive")
	}
	if err == nil || os.IsNotExist(err) {
		t.Fatalf("outage returned plausible cached absence instead of an unavailable error: %v", err)
	}
}

func (p *cacheGateOwnedProbe) notifications(t *testing.T, rescanAfter time.Time) {
	t.Helper()
	deadline := time.Now().Add(time.Second)
	for {
		seen := make(map[string]bool)
		rescan := false
		p.trace.mu.Lock()
		events := append([]cacheGateEvent(nil), p.trace.events...)
		p.trace.mu.Unlock()
		for _, event := range events {
			if !rescanAfter.IsZero() && event.Kind == "owned_notify_rescan" && !event.At.Before(rescanAfter) {
				rescan = true
				continue
			}
			if event.Kind != "owned_notify_completed" {
				continue
			}
			var notice struct {
				Action uint32
				Name   string
			}
			if err := json.Unmarshal(event.Fields, &notice); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if notice.Action == win.FILE_ACTION_ADDED {
				seen[strings.ToLower(notice.Name)] = true
			}
		}
		missing := make([]string, 0)
		for _, check := range p.checks {
			if rescan && !check.NegativeStarted.Before(rescanAfter) {
				continue
			}
			if !seen[strings.ToLower(check.Name)] {
				missing = append(missing, check.Name)
			}
		}
		if len(missing) == 0 {
			return
		}
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			t.Fatalf("owned recursive watcher omitted creation notifications: %v", missing)
		}
		time.Sleep(time.Millisecond)
	}
}

func cacheGateLimits() smb.Limits {
	limits := smb.DefaultLimits()
	if os.Getenv("RFS_GATE_VARIANT") == "owned_rescan" {
		limits.MaxNotifyEvents = 2
	}
	cacheGateObserve("diagnostic_notify_limit", map[string]int{"events": limits.MaxNotifyEvents})
	return limits
}

func cacheGatePendingCount(t *testing.T, trace *cacheGateTrace) int {
	t.Helper()
	trace.mu.Lock()
	defer trace.mu.Unlock()
	count := 0
	for _, event := range trace.events {
		if event.Kind != "smb_headers" {
			continue
		}
		var header nativeHeaderObservation
		if err := json.Unmarshal(event.Fields, &header); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if header.Response && header.Command == 15 && header.Status == 0x103 {
			count++
		}
	}
	return count
}

func cacheGateAwaitNewPending(t *testing.T, w *cacheGateOwnedWatcher, trace *cacheGateTrace, before int) {
	t.Helper()
	deadline := time.Now().Add(time.Second)
	for {
		w.mu.Lock()
		failure, active := w.failure, w.current != nil
		w.mu.Unlock()
		if failure != nil {
			t.Fatalf("watcher recovery failed: %v", failure)
		}
		if active && cacheGatePendingCount(t, trace) > before {
			cacheGateObserve("owned_recovery_admitted", nil)
			return
		}
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			t.Fatal("recovered watcher did not admit a new pending CHANGE_NOTIFY")
		}
		time.Sleep(time.Millisecond)
	}
}

func cacheGateOwnedRescan(t *testing.T, p *cacheGateOwnedProbe, w *cacheGateOwnedWatcher, session storage.FileSession, parent storage.File) {
	ordinaryPause := w.pauseAfterNext(t)
	_ = nativeRemoteCreateAt(t, session, parent, "trigger.bin", storage.NodeRegular)
	select {
	case <-ordinaryPause.reached:
	case <-time.After(time.Second):
		t.Fatal("setup notification did not pause")
	}
	rescanPause := w.pauseAfterRescan(t)
	p.trace.mu.Lock()
	beforeOverload := len(p.trace.events)
	p.trace.mu.Unlock()
	for i := range 8 {
		_ = nativeRemoteCreateAt(t, session, parent, fmt.Sprintf("overload-%d.bin", i), storage.NodeRegular)
	}
	// The next native request must prove ENUM; queue growth is never assumed.
	ordinaryPause.release()
	select {
	case <-rescanPause.reached:
	case <-time.After(time.Second):
		t.Fatal("bounded queue did not produce the required native rescan")
	}
	cacheGateAwaitEnum(t, p.trace, beforeOverload)
	before := cacheGatePendingCount(t, p.trace)
	gap := p.prime(t, `nested\deep\rescan-gap.bin`)
	_ = nativeRemoteCreateAt(t, session, parent, "rescan-gap.bin", storage.NodeRegular)
	p.acknowledged(t, gap)
	time.Sleep(100 * time.Millisecond)
	rescanPause.release()
	p.visible(t, gap)
	cacheGateAwaitNewPending(t, w, p.trace, before)
	later := p.prime(t, `nested\deep\after-rescan.bin`)
	_ = nativeRemoteCreateAt(t, session, parent, "after-rescan.bin", storage.NodeRegular)
	p.acknowledged(t, later)
	p.visible(t, later)
	cacheGateAwaitHealthy(t, w, p.trace)
	w.mu.Lock()
	failure, rescans := w.failure, w.rescans
	w.mu.Unlock()
	if failure != nil || rescans == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("rescan recovery state: count=%d error=%v", rescans, failure)
	}
}

func cacheGateAwaitHealthy(t *testing.T, w *cacheGateOwnedWatcher, trace *cacheGateTrace) {
	t.Helper()
	deadline := time.Now().Add(time.Second)
	for {
		w.mu.Lock()
		failure, active := w.failure, w.current != nil
		w.mu.Unlock()
		if failure != nil {
			t.Fatalf("owned watcher failed: %v", failure)
		}
		trace.mu.Lock()
		events := append([]cacheGateEvent(nil), trace.events...)
		trace.mu.Unlock()
		pending, outcome := -1, -1
		for i, event := range events {
			if event.Kind == "owned_notify_completed" || event.Kind == "owned_notify_rescan" {
				outcome = i
			}
			if event.Kind != "smb_headers" {
				continue
			}
			var header nativeHeaderObservation
			if err := json.Unmarshal(event.Fields, &header); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if header.Response && header.Command == 15 && header.Status == 0x103 {
				pending = i
			}
		}
		if active && pending > outcome {
			cacheGateObserve("owned_healthy_pending", nil)
			return
		}
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			t.Fatal("owned watcher has no healthy pending notification after its last completion")
		}
		time.Sleep(time.Millisecond)
	}
}

func cacheGateAwaitEnum(t *testing.T, trace *cacheGateTrace, after int) {
	t.Helper()
	deadline := time.Now().Add(time.Second)
	for {
		trace.mu.Lock()
		events := append([]cacheGateEvent(nil), trace.events[after:]...)
		trace.mu.Unlock()
		requests := make(map[uint64]bool)
		for _, event := range events {
			if event.Kind != "smb_headers" {
				continue
			}
			var header nativeHeaderObservation
			if err := json.Unmarshal(event.Fields, &header); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if header.Command != 15 {
				continue
			}
			if !header.Response {
				requests[header.MessageID] = true
			}
			if header.Response && header.Status == 0x10c && requests[header.MessageID] {
				cacheGateObserve("owned_wire_enum_confirmed", map[string]uint64{"message_id": header.MessageID})
				return
			}
		}
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			t.Fatal("native rescan had no corresponding SMB STATUS_NOTIFY_ENUM_DIR response")
		}
		time.Sleep(time.Millisecond)
	}
}

type cacheGateShareCase struct {
	Name              string
	Directory         bool
	ApplicationFirst  bool
	ApplicationAccess uint32
	ApplicationShare  uint32
	WatchAccess       uint32
}
type cacheGateShareResult struct {
	Platform         string
	Case             cacheGateShareCase
	SharingViolation bool
	SecondOpen       string
}

func cacheGateSharingOpen(t *testing.T, path string, access, share uint32, directory bool) (*nativeHandle, error) {
	t.Helper()
	name, err := win.UTF16PtrFromString(path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	flags := uint32(win.FILE_FLAG_OVERLAPPED)
	if directory {
		flags |= win.FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS
	}
	handle, err := win.CreateFile(name, access, share, nil, win.OPEN_EXISTING, flags, 0)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	file := &nativeHandle{value: handle}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if err := file.close(); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	})
	return file, nil
}

func cacheGateSharingAttempt(t *testing.T, trace *cacheGateTrace, platform, path string, test cacheGateShareCase) cacheGateShareResult {
	t.Helper()
	all := uint32(win.FILE_SHARE_READ | win.FILE_SHARE_WRITE | win.FILE_SHARE_DELETE)
	firstAccess, firstShare, secondAccess, secondShare := test.WatchAccess, all, test.ApplicationAccess, test.ApplicationShare
	secondName := "application"
	if test.ApplicationFirst {
		firstAccess, firstShare, secondAccess, secondShare = test.ApplicationAccess, test.ApplicationShare, test.WatchAccess, all
		secondName = "watcher"
	}
	cacheGateObserve("directory_sharing_open_attempt", map[string]any{"platform": platform, "case": test.Name, "stage": "first", "access": firstAccess, "share": firstShare})
	first, err := cacheGateSharingOpen(t, path, firstAccess, firstShare, test.Directory)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("first %s open: %v", platform, err)
	}
	if test.Directory && !test.ApplicationFirst {
		cacheGateSharingArm(t, trace, platform, first)
	}
	cacheGateObserve("directory_sharing_open_attempt", map[string]any{"platform": platform, "case": test.Name, "stage": "second", "access": secondAccess, "share": secondShare})
	second, err := cacheGateSharingOpen(t, path, secondAccess, secondShare, test.Directory)
	if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, win.ERROR_SHARING_VIOLATION) {
		t.Fatalf("second %s open: %v", platform, err)
	}
	result := cacheGateShareResult{Platform: platform, Case: test, SharingViolation: errors.Is(err, win.ERROR_SHARING_VIOLATION), SecondOpen: secondName}
	cacheGateObserve("directory_sharing_result", result)
	if err == nil && test.Directory && test.ApplicationFirst {
		cacheGateSharingArm(t, trace, platform, second)
	}
	return result
}

func cacheGateSharingArm(t *testing.T, trace *cacheGateTrace, platform string, file *nativeHandle) {
	t.Helper()
	before := cacheGatePendingCount(t, trace)
	_ = cacheGateStartWatch(t, file)
	if !strings.HasPrefix(platform, "smb_") {
		return
	}
	deadline := time.Now().Add(time.Second)
	for cacheGatePendingCount(t, trace) <= before {
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			t.Fatal("SMB directory sharing control had no admitted native watch")
		}
		time.Sleep(time.Millisecond)
	}
}

func cacheGateRequireNTFS(t *testing.T, path string) {
	t.Helper()
	file, err := cacheGateSharingOpen(t, path, win.FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES, win.FILE_SHARE_READ|win.FILE_SHARE_WRITE|win.FILE_SHARE_DELETE, true)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	name := make([]uint16, 64)
	var serial, maxName, flags uint32
	if err := win.GetVolumeInformationByHandle(file.value, nil, 0, &serial, &maxName, &flags, &name[0], uint32(len(name))); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	filesystem := win.UTF16ToString(name)
	cacheGateObserve("local_filesystem_control", map[string]string{"filesystem": filesystem})
	if filesystem != "NTFS" {
		t.Fatalf("local control requires NTFS, got %q", filesystem)
	}
	if err := file.close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func cacheGateSharingScenario(t *testing.T) {
	output := os.Getenv("RFS_GATE_OUTPUT_ROOT")
	if output == "" {
		t.Fatal("receipt output directory is required")
	}
	trace := &cacheGateTrace{}
	cacheGateActive.Store(trace)
	var bridge *nativeBridge
	var results []cacheGateShareResult
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		cacheGateActive.Store(nil)
		trace.mu.Lock()
		events := append([]cacheGateEvent(nil), trace.events...)
		overflow, encodeErr := trace.overflow, trace.encodingError
		trace.mu.Unlock()
		if overflow || encodeErr != nil {
			t.Errorf("incomplete sharing trace: overflow=%v error=%v", overflow, encodeErr)
		}
		report := map[string]any{"evidence_kind": "pinned prototype diagnostic; not PR implementation acceptance", "variant": "directory_sharing", "fixture_sha": os.Getenv("RFS_GATE_FIXTURE_SHA"), "gate_sha": os.Getenv("GITHUB_SHA"), "overlay_sha": os.Getenv("RFS_GATE_OVERLAY_SHA"), "test_failed": t.Failed(), "results": results, "events": events}
		if bridge != nil {
			report["final_server_status"] = bridge.smb.Status()
			report["final_backend_references"] = bridge.backend.openReferences()
		}
		encoded, err := json.MarshalIndent(report, "", "  ")
		if err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
			return
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(output, "receipt.json"), encoded, 0600); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	})
	parent := t.TempDir()
	directory := filepath.Join(parent, "sharing")
	if err := os.Mkdir(directory, 0700); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(parent, "parent-write-proof.bin"), []byte{1}, 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	cacheGateObserve("local_parent_write_proven", nil)
	cacheGateRequireNTFS(t, directory)
	raw, err := win.UTF16PtrFromString(directory)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	volume := make([]uint16, 32768)
	if err := win.GetVolumePathName(raw, &volume[0], uint32(len(volume))); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	volumeRoot := win.UTF16ToString(volume)
	sid, err := CurrentUserSID()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	policy, err := AllowSID(sid)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	bridge = nativeBridgeFixture(t, policy)
	if err := bridge.mapDrive(t); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	proof := nativeOpen(t, filepath.Join(bridge.path+`\`, "parent-write-proof.bin"), win.CREATE_ALWAYS)
	if n, err := nativeTransfer(proof, []byte{1}, true); err != nil || n != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("SMB parent write proof: count=%d error=%v", n, err)
	}
	if err := proof.close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	cacheGateObserve("smb_parent_write_proven", nil)
	_, _ = nativeRemoteOpen(t, bridge.remote, "sharing", storage.NodeDirectory, true)
	list := uint32(win.FILE_LIST_DIRECTORY)
	metadata := uint32(win.FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES)
	watchAccess := uint32(win.FILE_LIST_DIRECTORY | win.FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES | win.READ_CONTROL | win.SYNCHRONIZE)
	denyRead := uint32(win.FILE_SHARE_WRITE | win.FILE_SHARE_DELETE)
	cases := []cacheGateShareCase{
		{Name: "list_watcher_first", Directory: true, ApplicationAccess: list, ApplicationShare: denyRead, WatchAccess: watchAccess},
		{Name: "list_application_first", Directory: true, ApplicationFirst: true, ApplicationAccess: list, ApplicationShare: denyRead, WatchAccess: watchAccess},
		{Name: "metadata_watcher_first", Directory: true, ApplicationAccess: metadata, ApplicationShare: denyRead, WatchAccess: watchAccess},
		{Name: "metadata_application_first", Directory: true, ApplicationFirst: true, ApplicationAccess: metadata, ApplicationShare: denyRead, WatchAccess: watchAccess},
	}
	locations := []struct{ name, path string }{
		{"ntfs_directory", directory}, {"ntfs_volume_root", volumeRoot},
		{"smb_directory", `\\127.0.0.1\` + bridge.share + `\sharing`}, {"smb_export_root", `\\127.0.0.1\` + bridge.share},
	}
	subdirectories := make(map[string]map[string]bool)
	for _, location := range locations {
		subdirectories[location.name] = make(map[string]bool)
		for _, test := range cases {
			t.Run(location.name+"/"+test.Name, func(t *testing.T) {
				cacheGateObserve("directory_sharing_open_attempt", map[string]any{"platform": location.name, "case": test.Name, "stage": "baseline", "access": test.ApplicationAccess, "share": test.ApplicationShare})
				baseline, err := cacheGateSharingOpen(t, location.path, test.ApplicationAccess, test.ApplicationShare, true)
				if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, win.ERROR_SHARING_VIOLATION) {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				baselineBlocked := errors.Is(err, win.ERROR_SHARING_VIOLATION)
				if baseline != nil {
					if err := baseline.close(); err != nil {
						t.Fatal(err)
					}
				}
				cacheGateObserve("directory_sharing_baseline", map[string]any{"platform": location.name, "case": test.Name, "sharing_violation": baselineBlocked})
				if baselineBlocked {
					cacheGateObserve("directory_sharing_preexisting_conflict", map[string]string{"platform": location.name, "case": test.Name})
					t.Error("preexisting directory sharing conflict makes this control inconclusive")
					return
				}
				result := cacheGateSharingAttempt(t, trace, location.name, location.path, test)
				results = append(results, result)
				subdirectories[location.name][test.Name] = result.SharingViolation
			})
		}
	}
	for _, test := range cases {
		local, localOK := subdirectories["ntfs_directory"][test.Name]
		remote, remoteOK := subdirectories["smb_directory"][test.Name]
		if !localOK || !remoteOK {
			t.Errorf("directory sharing comparison is incomplete for %s", test.Name)
			continue
		}
		if local != remote {
			t.Errorf("SMB directory sharing differs from writable-parent NTFS for %s", test.Name)
		}
	}
	fileCase := cacheGateShareCase{Name: "regular_read_control", ApplicationAccess: win.GENERIC_READ, ApplicationShare: denyRead, WatchAccess: win.GENERIC_READ}
	for _, location := range []struct{ name, path string }{{"ntfs_regular", filepath.Join(parent, "parent-write-proof.bin")}, {"smb_regular", filepath.Join(bridge.path+`\`, "parent-write-proof.bin")}} {
		t.Run(location.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			result := cacheGateSharingAttempt(t, trace, location.name, location.path, fileCase)
			results = append(results, result)
			if !result.SharingViolation {
				t.Fatal("regular-file read-sharing control did not reject the conflicting open")
			}
		})
	}
	bridge.assertCacheContract(t)
}

func cacheGateFindCompatibility(t *testing.T, p *cacheGateOwnedProbe) {
	cacheGateStatusMappings(t)
	parent := t.TempDir()
	cacheGateRequireNTFS(t, parent)
	raw, err := win.UTF16PtrFromString(parent)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	volume := make([]uint16, 32768)
	if err := win.GetVolumePathName(raw, &volume[0], uint32(len(volume))); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	roots := []struct{ name, path string }{{"ntfs_volume_root", win.UTF16ToString(volume)}, {"smb_export_root", `\\127.0.0.1\` + p.bridge.share}}
	for _, root := range roots {
		for _, applicationFirst := range []bool{false, true} {
			t.Run(fmt.Sprintf("%s/application_first_%t", root.name, applicationFirst), func(t *testing.T) {
				cacheGateObserve("find_first_case", map[string]any{"platform": root.name, "application_first": applicationFirst})
				baseline, err := cacheGateSharingOpen(t, root.path, win.FILE_LIST_DIRECTORY, win.FILE_SHARE_WRITE|win.FILE_SHARE_DELETE, true)
				if err != nil {
					cacheGateObserve("find_first_baseline_failed", map[string]string{"error": err.Error()})
					t.Fatalf("preexisting root conflict or permission failure: %v", err)
				}
				if err := baseline.close(); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if applicationFirst {
					application, err := cacheGateSharingOpen(t, root.path, win.FILE_LIST_DIRECTORY, win.FILE_SHARE_WRITE|win.FILE_SHARE_DELETE, true)
					if err != nil {
						t.Fatal(err)
					}
					defer func() {
						if err := application.close(); err != nil {
							t.Error(err)
						}
					}()
				}
				before := cacheGatePendingCount(t, p.trace)
				handle, err := win.FindFirstChangeNotification(root.path, true, win.FILE_NOTIFY_CHANGE_FILE_NAME|win.FILE_NOTIFY_CHANGE_DIR_NAME)
				cacheGateObserve("find_first_open", map[string]any{"platform": root.name, "application_first": applicationFirst, "success": err == nil, "error": fmt.Sprint(err)})
				if err != nil {
					t.Errorf("FindFirstChangeNotification cannot coexist with the root open: %v", err)
					return
				}
				t.Cleanup(func() {
					if err := win.FindCloseChangeNotification(handle); err != nil {
						t.Error(err)
					}
					cacheGateObserve("find_first_closed", map[string]string{"platform": root.name})
				})
				if strings.HasPrefix(root.name, "smb_") {
					deadline := time.Now().Add(time.Second)
					for cacheGatePendingCount(t, p.trace) <= before {
						if time.Now().After(deadline) {
							t.Fatal("FindFirstChangeNotification had no admitted SMB CHANGE_NOTIFY")
						}
						time.Sleep(time.Millisecond)
					}
					cacheGateObserve("find_first_pending_confirmed", nil)
				}
				if !applicationFirst {
					application, err := cacheGateSharingOpen(t, root.path, win.FILE_LIST_DIRECTORY, win.FILE_SHARE_WRITE|win.FILE_SHARE_DELETE, true)
					cacheGateObserve("find_first_application_open", map[string]any{"platform": root.name, "success": err == nil, "error": fmt.Sprint(err)})
					if err != nil {
						t.Errorf("FindFirstChangeNotification changes the application's root-sharing behavior: %v", err)
						return
					}
					if err := application.close(); err != nil {
						t.Error(err)
					}
				}
			})
		}
	}
	cacheGateObserve("find_first_compatibility_gate", map[string]any{"compatible": !t.Failed(), "visibility_rearm_outage_acceptance": "requires subsequent proof if compatible"})
}

func cacheGateStatusMappings(t *testing.T) {
	t.Helper()
	mapper := win.NewLazySystemDLL("ntdll.dll").NewProc("RtlNtStatusToDosError")
	if err := mapper.Find(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, status := range []uint32{0xc000000f, 0xc0000034, 0xc000003a} {
		// The return value is the mapping; GetLastError is not an output of this API.
		code, _, _ := mapper.Call(uintptr(status))
		cacheGateObserve("ntstatus_translation_only", map[string]any{"ntstatus": status, "win32": uint32(code), "wire_status_changed": false})
	}
}
